items.title: Why Western Digital Stock Is Tumbling Despite A Big Earnings Beat
items.summary: Western Digital stock fell sharply Thursday despite the hard-disk drive maker posting a big earnings beat for its fiscal fourth-quarter.  The results may be overshadowed from what analysts called an even stronger report from rival Seagate Technology last week.  Western Digital, which recently rebranded as WD, said late Wednesday that Q4 revenue jumped 44% year-over-year to $3.75 billion, helped by AI-driven demand in cloud data centers.

items.title: Why Is Western Digital Stock Sinking Thursday?
items.summary: Western Digital Corp. (NASDAQ:WDC) stock traded lower Thursday despite reporting fiscal fourth-quarter earnings and revenue that beat Wall Street estimates. Despite the earnings beat, Western Digital’s outlook fell short of elevated investor expectations, triggering a sector-wide pullback in AI memory and storage stocks.
